hero.tagline: All 6 door codes and keypad passwords, with the clues that reveal each one.
hero.intro: Codes are fixed across every playthrough. Most unlock lore, secrets, and collectibles rather than story progression.

codes.how: Leave the Locker Room and return to the Atrium. Climb the stairs to the upper level, use the Utility Strap to open the shutter across from the landing, then use the device again through the window to unlock the door. Inside, the security camera (CCTV) feed displays the code on screen.

A sticky note on Carter's monitor reads "Luna" with a party hat drawn next to it. Check the calendar in the adjacent room: Luna's birthday is August 28. Enter 0828 (US date format) — 2808 also works in some versions.

During the search of the Mess Hall, use the Wedge Tool to open the only wedge-accessible side room in the far corner. As you leave, look at the door frame — a handwritten note there gives the code. Enter it at the Kitchen pantry keypad to reveal a lore secret.
Match the three chemical structures shown on the Diazepam display to their numbered cabinet labels: Chloroacetyl chloride = 1, Ammonia = 6, Dimethyl sulphate = 8.

While playing as Cernan in Bridge Ops, go through the door to the right of the locked terminal and follow the hallway to the cockpit. A note near the pilot's chair reads "Anomaly log code: CAIF." Convert letters to alphabet positions: C=3, A=1, I=9, F=6.
The terminal requests the probe's serial number. Inspect the probe front (shows "2") and back (shows "40"), giving the pattern 2_40. The complete serial number is 2540.

cheats.heading: Does Directive 8020 Have Cheats?
cheats.intro: **No.** There are no cheat codes or console commands in Directive 8020. If you want an easier run, your legitimate options are:
items: **Explorer mode** — more generous QTE timers and clearer telegraphing of dangerous choices
**Turning Points** — jump back to any major decision via chapter select to fix mistakes without a full replay

sections.heading: Confirmed replay rules
sections.text: Explorer allows Turning Points during the story. Survivor commits you to decisions on the first run and unlocks Turning Points if you reach the ending. These rules do not prove the requirements of a particular ending or password.

sections.heading: Before route advice is restored
sections.text: A reproducible record must identify the platform, game version, prior choices, actual prompt and observed result. The old details are retained for editorial review but are not published as current instructions. Use the official sources below and the verified controls guide while this review is pending.
